package.description: A fast, open-source IPTV player for M3U playlists and Xtream Codes accounts.

en-US.description: A fast, open-source IPTV player for M3U playlists and Xtream Codes accounts.
en-US.longDescription:
Streamlity plays live TV, movies and series from your own IPTV provider. Add an M3U playlist or an Xtream Codes account and get a dark, keyboard-friendly desktop player with a grid program guide (EPG), catch-up, multiview for up to four channels, movies and series with resume, search, parental controls and an interface in 12 languages.
Streamlity is only a player: it doesn't include or sell any channels or content.
en-US.name: Streamlity
